content.summary: Options ranked by time-to-learning for collapsible /changes sidebar + fuzzy filter

data.problem: Implement true collapsible directory nodes and fuzzy filename/path filtering in /changes while preserving keyboard navigation, selection-driven diff behavior, and validating the recent comment reset fix.
constraints: Must preserve stage grouping (staged/unstaged/untracked) and duplicate file visibility across stages.
Must preserve current selection -> DiffPane behavior and click/keyboard parity.
Must not break dialog-stack hotkey isolation for comment prompts.
Collapse state must persist across navigation/refresh and only drop paths that no longer exist.
Scope should stay mostly in file-list.tsx unless selection contract changes require parent updates.

options.name: Single-file row-model refactor in FileList
options.approach: Refactor file-list.tsx to build stage trees + collapse map + filtered visible rows, while keeping existing selected index and onSelect contract. Add fuzzysort-based matching directly in component and render toggle rows for directories.
options.what_we_learn: Whether existing FileList state model can absorb collapse+filter features without touching parent route or DiffPane.
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium: logic density in one file can raise regression risk in keyboard and selection edge cases.
options.ux_tradeoffs: Fastest delivery, but keyboard/focus behavior can feel brittle if filter typing and navigation are not clearly separated.

options.name: Extract pure view-model transformer then integrate
options.approach: Create a pure transformer for stage tree + collapse pruning + fuzzy filter + visible rows, unit-test it, then wire FileList rendering/keyboard against that stable output.
options.what_we_learn: Whether tree/filter behavior can be made deterministic and testable before UI wiring, reducing hidden regressions.
options.risk_if_wrong: Low-medium: more upfront structure, but reduced runtime surprises.
options.ux_tradeoffs: Slightly slower path, but usually yields more consistent behavior for collapsed/filtered edge cases.

options.name: Route-level state orchestration for filter+selection
options.approach: Lift filter and active-row state to changes/index.tsx, pass controlled props into FileList, and gate route-level hotkeys when filter is focused. Treat FileList as mostly presentational.
options.what_we_learn: Whether centralizing state improves long-term extensibility (saved filters, richer shortcuts, cross-pane coordination).
options.risk_if_wrong: Medium-high: larger surface area and more chances to break existing behavior.
options.ux_tradeoffs: Most flexible future UX, but highest chance of temporary keybinding confusion during iteration.

data.recommendation: Option 1 first because it is the fastest useful path that can validate AC-1..AC-6 with minimal file surface. If edge-case regressions appear, pivot immediately to Option 2 by extracting the transformer without discarding the UI work.
